Cover your head and neck. Help anyone who needs assistance to get there.

Do not try to travel to a distant shelter once a warning is issued unless officials direct it and you planned it in advance.

pages.title: If this happens: Freeze with power loss

lines.text: Move to your agreed cooled place before the home heats up, especially anyone who is heat-sensitive.
A fan alone may not prevent heat illness in extreme heat.
Call 911 for signs of heat stroke, such as confusion, fainting, or a very high body temperature.
Ask the care provider in advance how heat or a power outage affects medicines and equipment. Do not change medicines on your own.

pages.title: If this happens: Heat wave with grid strain

lines.text: Follow the exact advisory from your water utility. Different advisories need different actions.
Boil water advisory: use bottled or stored water, or bring tap water to a rolling boil for 1 minute (3 minutes above 6,500 feet), as your utility advises.
Do not drink advisory: do not drink the tap water and do not boil it. Boiling does not remove chemicals.
Do not use advisory: do not use tap water for any purpose. Use stored or bottled water.
